source_dataset: Indian Patent Office (IPO / InPASS) & TKDL Patent Corpus
title: Synergistic botanical composition comprising Boswellia serrata and Commiphora mukul for inflammatory joint diseases
text: Under Section 3(e) of the Indian Patents Act, evidence of synergy was submitted demonstrating that AKBA and guggulsterones act on complementary biological targets: 5-LOX inhibition and NF-kappa-B suppression respectively.
